dialogues.en:
I'm like a husband who nervously walks back and forth in
front of a labor room.
dialogues.text:
I'm like a husband who nervously walks back and forth in
front of a labor room.

dialogues.jp:
組んだ両手の上にあごを乗せ、ちらりと時計に
目をやる。
dialogues.en: So I go to the kitchen to see how she's doing.
dialogues.text: So I go to the kitchen to see how she's doing.

dialogues.jp:
時刻は７時。全国のお茶の間でも、そろそろみ
んなで夕飯を取ろうってな時間帯だろう。
dialogues.en: "Ah...... Are you done?"
dialogues.text: "Ah...... Are you done?"

dialogues.jp:
そして、我が朝倉家でもそれは例外でない。台
所から、調理の音が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en:
She's standing in front of a boiling pot, and she turns
around.
dialogues.text:
She's standing in front of a boiling pot, and she turns
around.

dialogues.jp: 「はうぅ……」
dialogues.en: Her face is red with embarrassment.
dialogues.text: Her face is red with embarrassment.

dialogues.jp:
産婦人科の病院にて、廊下を行ったり来たり｛せわ／忙｝
しない父親の心境だった。

そんな訳で、ついつい様子を見に行ったりなん
ぞしてしまう。
dialogues.en: "Wh-What?"
dialogues.text: "Wh-What?"

dialogues.jp: 「あの……出来た？」
dialogues.en: "You can not come into the kitchen......"
dialogues.text: "You can not come into the kitchen......"

dialogues.jp:
ぐつぐつと煮立っている鍋の前で、頼子さんは
すっと振り返った。
dialogues.en: "Ah, yeah...... okay."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yeah...... okay."

dialogues.jp: そして、恥ずかしげに頬を赤らめる。
dialogues.en:
I see an unexpected beauty and a strong will in her smile,
and I weakly walk away from the kitchen.
dialogues.text:
I see an unexpected beauty and a strong will in her smile,
and I weakly walk away from the kitchen.

dialogues.jp:
何だか、｛かれん／可憐｝さと｛きょうじん／強靱｝さをふたつながら感じさ
せる笑顔に、俺はすごすごと退散する。

dialogues.en: I really do feel like a father or a husband......
dialogues.text: I really do feel like a father or a husband......

dialogues.jp: つくづく、父親を演じているような……。

dialogues.en: "Let's e-e-e-eat."
dialogues.text: "Let's e-e-e-eat."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あいや、ごめんごめん。何でもないっす」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I'm sorry. It's nothing."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I'm sorry. It's nothing."

dialogues.jp: 緊張のあまり、口が｛ゆる／弛｝んでいた。
dialogues.en: I'm so nervous I can't speak right.
dialogues.text: I'm so nervous I can't speak right.

dialogues.jp:
テーブルの上には、冷水の入ったコップとほか
ほかと湯気を立てるカレーライスが載っている。
dialogues.en:
On the table, there are two cups of cold water and two
plates of hot steaming curry and rice.
dialogues.text:
On the table, there are two cups of cold water and two
plates of hot steaming curry and rice.

dialogues.jp: 「では……いざ参る」
dialogues.en: "Well...... I can do it."
dialogues.text: "Well...... I can do it."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あいや、ごめんごめん。何でもないっす」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I am sorry. It's nothing."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I am sorry. It's nothing."

dialogues.jp:
ふと、昔、金属バットを持ったさくらに追いか
けられた時の体験を思い出した。
dialogues.en:
All of a sudden, I remember how tense I was when I was once
chased by a scary man with a bat.
dialogues.text:
All of a sudden, I remember how tense I was when I was once
chased by a scary man with a bat.

dialogues.jp:
……夕飯ごときで、何で、果たし合いの緊迫感
に包まれにゃならんのだ。
dialogues.en:
...Why do I have to feel so tense and nervous for just a
dinner...?
dialogues.text:
...Why do I have to feel so tense and nervous for just a
dinner...?

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは頼子さんで、俺とは別の意味で緊張
しているらしい。
dialogues.en: Yoriko looks nervous as well, for a different reason.
dialogues.text: Yoriko looks nervous as well, for a different reason.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ……いただきます」
dialogues.en: "Well...... let's eat."
dialogues.text: "Well...... let's eat."

dialogues.jp:
今度はきちんと口が動く。テーブルの向こうで、
頼子さんが固く微笑んだ。
dialogues.en:
Now I can say it right. Yoriko nervously smiles in front of
me.
dialogues.text:
Now I can say it right. Yoriko nervously smiles in front of
me.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい、その……どうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes, please."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes, please."

dialogues.jp:
ピカリ、と蛍光灯を反射するスプーンを手に取
る。
dialogues.en:
I take a spoon and it reflects fluorescent light into my
eyes.
dialogues.text:
I take a spoon and it reflects fluorescent light into my
eyes.

dialogues.jp: （匂いは美味そうだよな……）
dialogues.en: (It smells good......)
dialogues.text: (It smells good......)

dialogues.jp:
不安感が少し減るのと入れ替わりに、空腹感が
少し増す。
dialogues.en: As my anxiety decreases, a hunger increases instead.
dialogues.text: As my anxiety decreases, a hunger increases instead.

dialogues.jp:
（食材を買ってきたのは俺だから……変なのも
　入っていないはず）
dialogues.en:
(I bought all the ingredients, so...... there shouldn't be
any strange food inside.)
dialogues.text:
(I bought all the ingredients, so...... there shouldn't be
any strange food inside.)

dialogues.jp:
さくりとスプーンを突き立てる。人参が丸ごと
入っている、という事もない。どれもこれも、
程良い大きさに切られている。
dialogues.en:
I put my spoon into the curry. I don't see a whole big
carrot inside the curry or anything. All the vegetables are
cut in an appropriate size.
dialogues.text:
I put my spoon into the curry. I don't see a whole big
carrot inside the curry or anything. All the vegetables are
cut in an appropriate size.

dialogues.jp: （匂いも見た目も問題なし……か。よし！）
dialogues.en: (It smells good and it looks good...... Okay!)
dialogues.text: (It smells good and it looks good...... Okay!)

dialogues.jp:
突き立てたスプーンいっぱいに載せる。そして
一気に、のどの奥へと押し込んだ。
dialogues.en:
I put a lot of curry on the spoon. And I carry it all the
way inside my mouth.
dialogues.text:
I put a lot of curry on the spoon. And I carry it all the
way inside my mouth.

dialogues.jp:
テーブルの上で、視線がぶつかり合う。ごくり
と飲み込んだ。
dialogues.en: Our eyes meet across the table. I swallowed the mouthful.
dialogues.text: Our eyes meet across the table. I swallowed the mouthful.

dialogues.jp: 「う……美味い」
dialogues.en: "Ug...... Good."
dialogues.text: "Ug...... Good."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「うん、美味いよ、頼子さん」
dialogues.en: "It's great, Yoriko-san."
dialogues.text: "It's great, Yoriko-san."

dialogues.jp:
そりゃ、目ん玉おっ飛び出る程の味って訳じゃ
ないが、普通に美味しい。
dialogues.en:
It wasn't a 'my eyes pop out' kind of good, but it tastes as
good as normal curry.
dialogues.text:
It wasn't a 'my eyes pop out' kind of good, but it tastes as
good as normal curry.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「よ、良かったです……」
dialogues.en: "I am so glad......"
dialogues.text: "I am so glad......"

dialogues.jp:
心底ホッとしたのか、胸元に手をあて、小さく
息をつく。
dialogues.en:
She looks relieved from the bottom of her heart, and she
gives a relieved sigh with her hands on her chest.
dialogues.text:
She looks relieved from the bottom of her heart, and she
gives a relieved sigh with her hands on her chest.

dialogues.jp:
「うん、美味いなこりゃ、ほんとに。ほら、頼
　子さんも見てないで、食べようよ」
dialogues.en:
"Yeas, this is really good. Yoriko-san, you should try it,
too."
dialogues.text:
"Yeas, this is really good. Yoriko-san, you should try it,
too."

dialogues.jp:
スプーンを手に取り、今度は正真正銘の笑顔を
浮かべた。さっきのような固いそれではなくて。
dialogues.en:
She takes a spoon in her hand, and this time she really
smiles, not like the nervous-looking smile she had earlier.
dialogues.text:
She takes a spoon in her hand, and this time she really
smiles, not like the nervous-looking smile she had earlier.

dialogues.jp:
かちゃかちゃとスプーンの音が飛ぶ。俺はせっ
せと口の中に放り込んだ。
dialogues.en:
There are sounds of our spoons hitting the plates. And I eat
fast.
dialogues.text:
There are sounds of our spoons hitting the plates. And I eat
fast.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「くす……朝倉さん、また頬がリスみたいになっ
　てますよ」
dialogues.en:
"Teehee... Junichi-san, you look like a squirrel with
swollen cheeks again."
dialogues.text:
"Teehee... Junichi-san, you look like a squirrel with
swollen cheeks again."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「うむむ……」

先日の臨死体験が思い出される。コップの水で
口の中を洗い流し、普通に食べる事にする。
dialogues.en:
I remember the near-death experience of the other day. So I
drink water and start eating slower.
dialogues.text:
I remember the near-death experience of the other day. So I
drink water and start eating slower.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの……まだ、たくさんありますからね」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... There is more left if you want."
dialogues.text: "Ah...... There is more left if you want."

dialogues.jp: そう言って席を立つと、台所へと向かった。
dialogues.en: Says she as she stands up and walks to the kitchen.
dialogues.text: Says she as she stands up and walks to the kitchen.

dialogues.jp: （たくさんか……たくさん？）
dialogues.en: (More left...... @
dialogues.text: (More left...... @

dialogues.jp:
もしゃもしゃ食べながら、はたと思い当たる。
俺、どのくらい買ったんだっけか……？
dialogues.en: More?)
dialogues.text: More?)

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「んしょ……おぃしょ……」
dialogues.en:
As I'm chewing food in my mouth, I try to remember how much
food I bought today......
dialogues.text:
As I'm chewing food in my mouth, I try to remember how much
food I bought today......

dialogues.jp:
空耳だろうか？　およそ１０時の方角──台所
から、｛ふおん／不穏｝な声が聞こえた気が……。

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「んん……よぃしょ」

ドダンッ。コップが揺れた。ついでに、俺の脳
も揺れた。
dialogues.en: Thunk! Cups jump up on the table. And so does my brain......
dialogues.text: Thunk! Cups jump up on the table. And so does my brain......

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ご、ごめんなさい……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I am sorry......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, I am sorry......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「……ああ、いやいや。大丈夫。こぼれちゃい
　ない」
dialogues.en: "......Ah, don't worry. You didn't spill anything."
dialogues.text: "......Ah, don't worry. You didn't spill anything."

dialogues.jp: しかし、残念ながら問題はそっちではなかった。
dialogues.en: But the problem isn't that.
dialogues.text: But the problem isn't that.

dialogues.jp:
広大な領域を占有した鍋に、思わず｛うめ／呻｝きがもれ
そうになってしまう。１０人家族か、朝倉家は。
dialogues.en:
The pot takes up the majority of the space on the table and
I'm about to gasp in shock. I don't see 10 people in this
house...
dialogues.text:
The pot takes up the majority of the space on the table and
I'm about to gasp in shock. I don't see 10 people in this
house...

dialogues.jp:
俺の｛めまい／眩暈｝をよそに、頼子さんはにこにこと嬉し
げだ。
dialogues.en:
Yoriko is happily smiling without noticing that I am still
blinking in shock.
dialogues.text:
Yoriko is happily smiling without noticing that I am still
blinking in shock.

dialogues.jp: 席に着くと、スプーン片手に彼女は言った。
dialogues.en: She sits down and takes a spoon in her hand.
dialogues.text: She sits down and takes a spoon in her hand.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの……まだまだ、たくさんありますからね」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... We have more left."
dialogues.text: "Ah...... We have more left."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いっぱい……食べて下さいね」
dialogues.en: "Please eat as much as you want."
dialogues.text: "Please eat as much as you want."

dialogues.jp: しかし、こんなでかい鍋が家にあったとは……。
dialogues.en: ...I didn't know I had a pot this big in the house...
dialogues.text: ...I didn't know I had a pot this big in the house...

dialogues.jp: 不覚。
dialogues.en: Shoot...
dialogues.text: Shoot...

dialogues.jp: ◆初めての料理◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんの初料理、果たして……。
dialogues.en: I put my chin on my hands and glance at the clock.
dialogues.text: I put my chin on my hands and glance at the clock.

dialogues.jp:
覚悟やらなにやら色々な思いを胸に食した俺だ
が、普通に美味しかった。
dialogues.en:
It's 7 pm. It's time for all the houses in Japan to start
cooking.
dialogues.text:
It's 7 pm. It's time for all the houses in Japan to start
cooking.

dialogues.jp:
ただ作った量というのが、十人家族もビックリ
という大容量だったけど……。
dialogues.en:
And our house is no exception -- I can hear sounds of
cooking from the kitchen.
dialogues.text:
And our house is no exception -- I can hear sounds of
cooking from the kitchen.

dialogues.jp:
俺はこんなでかい鍋が、家にあったことを初め
て知った。
